versions.content:
[SWS_DM_01471] Redirection to token endpoint
⌈
If the SOVD server re-
ceives a request for the resource for Requesting a Token then the DM shall call
the method ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::GetTokenUrl on the application
port mapped via mapping to the SoftwareCluster with category PLATFORM and
respond with a HTTP status code 307 Temporary Redirect and the Location
header set to the URL that is returned from the method call.
⌋
